title: Bigfoot spotted at an '80s-inspired ski lodge bar in Huntington Beach
excerpt: The Pier Summit Ski Lodge, a holiday pop-up at the Kimpton Shorebreak Hotel, rocks a certain neon kitsch.
content:
THE LAST WEEK OF OCTOBER... is famous for all sorts of fanciful creatures, the bump-in-the-night characters that fill out our films and novels and eeriest daydreams. But there is one cool cryptid now holding court in Huntington Beach, and this guy really is more about yuletide cocktails rather than Halloween candy. You'll find him and other colorful details at the Pier Summit Ski Lodge, an '80s-inspired bar that returns to the Kimpton Shorebreak Hotel each year, just around the time Halloween arrives. The yeti-inspired figure standing near the entrance, the one sporting the snazzy ski goggles, isn't the only eye-catching element at the lively location; glowing bulbs, a lounge-ready couch, and cabin-like features add to the mountain-style appearance (something that isn't often experienced just steps from the beach). As for the libations that will grace the menu at the holiday pop-up, which will be open through Jan. 2?

BIG FOOT... is indeed the name of one of the themed drinks — the bourbon has graham cracker kick, while chocolate and vanilla add further flavor — and Snow Bunny is a pink sip boasting framboise, cranberry juice, vodka, and other enticing elements. A Hot Toddy Time Machine is keeping it toasty, while the Ski Lift is the choice for espresso enthusiasts. And if you're keen to try a Shot Ski with a friend or even three pals? That, too, is happening (this is indeed to tradition where shots are placed in a ski and quaffed by more than one patron). Food meant to stoke an alpine appetite is also on the Pier Summit Ski Lodge line-up, with a Brotzeit Board featuring cured meats and more and Fireside Fondues that can be sweet or savory. For everything schussing into this Huntington Beach establishment, ride the gondola over to this site. Oh yes: This is all outdoors, so bundle up, ski bunnies, for your slopes-meets-the-sands adventure.
